mapper.select: SELECT i.inquiry_id AS id, i.user_id AS userId, i.type AS type, i.product_id AS productId, p.name AS productName, i.title AS title, CASE WHEN u.name IS NULL OR u.name = '' THEN '고객' ELSE CONCAT(SUBSTRING(u.name, 1, 1), '**') END AS author, i.status AS status, i.created_at AS createdAt, i.answer AS answerContent FROM inquiries i LEFT JOIN products p ON i.product_id = p.product_id LEFT JOIN users u ON i.user_id = u.user_id WHERE i.user_id = #{userId} ORDER BY i.created_at DESC
